templates.notes: Primary closed or semi-closed enum selector for category-defining type, condition, gender, or core state.
Secondary enum selector for material, color, purpose, or other narrowing attributes.
General numeric range for price, power, weight, volume, screen size, and similar numeric attributes.
Size-aware selector. It may expose raw seller size, normalized size, and system-specific size fields.
Brand is searchable and matchable, but not every archetype requires a curated brand graph.
Shared base controls for condition and price surfaces.
Compatibility selector for host product, vehicle, phone model, connector, or use-case compatibility.
Technical/spec-heavy numeric range that should not become a primary facet by default.
Consumable safety surface for ingredients, allergens, dietary flags, and safety warnings.
Age, life-stage, grade, or eligibility selector for kids, pets, and regulated consumables.
